text: Level three, question seven: an article is sold at a ten percent loss; had it been sold for ninety rupees more, there would have been a five percent gain; find the cost price. Question eight: A sells to B at a ten percent profit, and B sells to C at a twenty percent loss; C pays thirteen hundred and twenty rupees; find A's cost price. Question nine: the profit percent when an article is sold for one thousand and forty rupees equals the loss percent when it is sold for eight hundred and eighty; find the cost price and that percentage.
